keywords: EIP-8141 到期机制改为 frame 模式
EIP-8131 与 EIP-8279 底价与 gas limit 解耦
summary: nerolation 提交 EIP-8141 PR，试验把到期机制从特殊目标的 VERIFY frame 改回新的 frame 模式；Marchhill 指出到期验证器安装时没有规定 nonce。nero 还把 EIP-8131 的数据底价和 EIP-8279 的 BAL 底价写成与 gas limit 无关。Derek Chiang 指出 Base 到以太坊的多证明者桥要 1 天，比到 Solana 还慢。L2BEAT 隐私页新增“资金发现”板块。

items.title: EIP-8141：把到期 frame 改为新模式
items.note: （nerolation）提交。PR 说明这是若从特殊目标的 VERIFY frame 改回新 frame 模式时规范会是什么样子。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: make the expiry frame a new mode
items.note_en: (nerolation), submitted. The PR says this is what the spec would look like if expiry reverted from a special-target VERIFY frame to a new frame mode.
items.topic_en: The expiry mechanism for frame transactions

items.title: EIP-8141：说明安装到期验证器不改变 nonce
items.note: （Marchhill）提交。规范只要求在激活时把到期验证器的运行时代码装到 `EXPIRY_VERIFIER`，账户 nonce 没有规定；其他系统合约预部署的 nonce 为 1，但那是部署机制的结果而非刻意选择，EIP-2935 对此有明确说明。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: state that installing the expiry verifier leaves the nonce
items.note_en: (Marchhill), submitted. The spec only requires installing the expiry verifier runtime code at `EXPIRY_VERIFIER` at activation, leaving the account nonce open; other system contract predeploys sit at nonce 1, but there it follows from the deployment mechanism rather than being a chosen value, as EIP-2935 says directly.

keywords_en: EIP-8141 expiry as a frame mode
EIP-8131 and EIP-8279 floors decoupled from the gas limit
summary_en: nerolation submitted an EIP-8141 PR sketching the expiry mechanism as a new frame mode instead of a special-target VERIFY frame, and Marchhill noted that installing the expiry verifier leaves its nonce unspecified. nero also wrote EIP-8131's data floor and EIP-8279's BAL floor as independent of the gas limit. Derek Chiang pointed out that Base's multi-prover bridge to Ethereum takes a day, slower than bridging to Solana. L2BEAT's privacy pages added a "note discovery" section.
